title: WurEvent
description: One row of $RUN_DIR/events.jsonl: the join of stream.jsonl with gate/tool_calls.jsonl on tool_use_id, produced by lib/wur/events.py. join_coverage >= 0.99 is a pilot gate. Written one JSON object per line; validate line by line. Two rules bind every producer: (1) counting must group by message_id, never by stream line — stream.jsonl splits one assistant message across lines exactly like the on-disk transcript, so a per-line count inherits the V7 double-count bug; (2) result_digest is computed only AFTER nonce scanning, never before.

channel.description: The closed channel enum. attachment_<type> is a family keyed by the transcript's attachment.attachment.type. regions.py emits unknown_visible for any model-visible region it cannot map, and unknown_visible FAILS CI — the enum is not allowed to drift silently. Duplicated verbatim in fact_trace.schema.json; the two must stay in sync.

match_form.description: How the nonce matched. Only `exact` inbound hits set first_exposure_seq: a lowercased or hyphen-stripped nonce in a tool result is almost certainly the agent's own prior text being re-read.

seq.description: Monotonic index over the run's ordered events. The ordering invariant first_exposure_seq < first_mention_seq is checked in these units.

ts.description: ISO-8601 where the backend supplies one; null otherwise.

type.description: The base set is assistant/tool_use/tool_result/probe_in/probe_out/hook. Three additive values carry stream records that have no other home: harness_in (a non-probe stdin injection, i.e. RESUME_TEXT), system_init (the system/init event whose canonicalized hash is init_sha256), and result (the terminal event whose usage totals must equal the message_id-deduped totals).

source.description: Which raw artifact this row was derived from. transcript.jsonl is load-bearing, not a convenience copy: it is the ONLY source of truncation information.

message_id.description: assistant `message.id`. The dedupe key for every per-message count (V7/V17). Null on user/tool_result lines — they carry no message id, which is why turns_total is assistant-only.

tool_use_id.description: The stream<->gate join key. Gate ordinals are NOT tool-call ordinals: a denied call costs two barrier fires, so de-duplicate gate/tool_calls.jsonl by this field.

parent_tool_use_id.description: Set means a sidechain call; impossible with --tools and stamped probe_integrity: "sidechain_barrier" if seen.

is_probe_turn.description: THE field that keeps the instrument out of the measurement — probe turns are excluded from tool counts, phase splits and nav entropy. Keyed off the replayed probe_id TEXT, never off position: the probe is replayed as a user block immediately AFTER the barriered call's tool_result.

injection_kind.description: For rows the driver put on stdin. RESUME_TEXT is sent identically in the no-probe arms, so `resume` rows appear in every arm.

tool.description: Tool name, one of the frozen six (Bash, Read, Write, Edit, Glob, Grep).

tool_input.description: Verbatim tool input as the barrier saw it.

barrier.description: Ordinal of the PreToolUse barrier fire from gate/tool_calls.jsonl. Not a tool-call ordinal.

result_digest.description: Digest of the tool result, computed AFTER nonce scanning (scan-before-truncate).

is_error.description: tool_result.is_error. True with no content and no sidecar is the 256 KB Read ceiling -> read_error, not a tool_read region.

nonce_hits.description: Every fact nonce found in this event's model-visible regions. Empty array, never null, when nothing matched.

offset.description: Byte offset of the hit within the region.

model_visible.description: Fixed per channel. False regions (sidecar_only, persisted_output_ondisk) are diagnostic and NEVER count as exposure.

inbound.description: Fixed per channel. self_thinking is model-visible but NOT inbound — it is the D4 carve-out that sets read while leaving read_inbound_only alone.

bytes_before.description: Context position at the moment of exposure.

truncated_by_cli.description: The CLI elided content before the model saw it. Triggers: a <persisted-output> prefix, a persistedOutputPath sidecar, or file.numLines < file.totalLines SOURCED FROM transcript.jsonl. toolUseResult.file.truncated is None on every read and is NOT a trigger. stream.jsonl carries zero truncation information.

tokens_in.description: Deduped by message_id — carry usage on the FIRST row of a message_id group and null on the rest, or sum inflates 1.0x-4.9x.

extra.description: Documented extension point. Producers that need a field this contract does not name put it here rather than breaking additionalProperties:false; anything promoted to a real field is a schema change, reviewed.
